entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad

sentences.text:
Case :- Application U/S 529 Bnss No. - 1159 of 2025
Applicant :- Rajesh Pandey

Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Shiv Babu Dubey
Counsel for Opposite Party :- Chandra Prakash Garg,G.A.
Hon'ble Nalin Kumar Srivastava,J.
1.

This application under Section 529 Bnss has been filed with a prayer to direct the court
concerned to decide the Criminal Case No. 3041 of 2023 in case crime no. 281 of 2021 under
Sections 419, 420, 467, 468, 471 and 120-B I.P.C., Police Station-Jhunsi, District- Prayagraj pending
in the Court of learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Fifth, Prayagraj expeditiously within
stipulated period.

entities.text: Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Fifth, Prayagraj
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 2. Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned counsel for the respondent no.2 as well as learned A.G.A. for the State.

3. It is submitted by the learned counsel for the applicant that the said criminal case is pending since 2023 and in the aforesaid police chalani case accused/ opposite party no.2 has appeared before the Court but however, no charge has been framed so far.
The Court concerned is not taking proper interest in disposal of the said case.

entities.text: Rajesh Pandey vs State Of U.P. And Another on 8 May, 2025 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 5. I have considered the submissions and perused the record.

6. Learned counsel for the opposite party no.2 is also present and he had taken an under taking that he is ready and willing to cooperate with the trial Court and on the next date he will cooperate the Court on the point of framing of charge.

7. In the circumstances, the Court concerned is directed to make all endeavours to decide the aforesaid case expeditiously without granting unnecessary adjournment to either of the parties.
8.

It is also made clear that the Court / Presiding Officer is not the only stake holder in the trial and disposal of a case, hence, besides the P.O. concerned, all the stake holders i.e. police and executive authorities, counsels, parties to the case, staff etc. are also made bound by this order and it will be their responsibility also to assist the Court in every manner for the expeditious disposal of this case.
9. With the above observations, the application stands disposed of.
Order Date :- 8.5.2025//Fhd  Rajesh Pandey vs State Of U.P. And Another on 8 May, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/10445765/
